## Birthweight Z-Score and Placental Transcriptome- Results Comparison

This code will compare the results of the Birthweight Z-Score and Placental Transcriptome Analysis that is part of the Cell Proportions project in CANDLE/PATHWAYS GAPPS N=1009. Here I ran the BW Z-Score -> Transcriptome analysis 3 ways. All covariates were kept the same except for treatment of cell proportions: 

1) Birthweight
2) Birthweight + All Cell Types - 1 (Leave one out compositional regression)
3) Birthweight + Cell Proportions PCA (PCs >5% variance included=7)

### Load Packages
```{r packages}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggvenn)
library(UpSetR)
```

### Load Data
Loading Differentially expressed genes (FDR<0.05) for each model
```{r load data}
BW <- read.csv("/Volumes/paquette_a/slapehn/CellProportions_CANDLE_GAPPS/Results/BirthweightTranscriptome/BWz_DEGS_FDR<0.05_noCellProp_112125.csv")
BW_CellProp_LOO <- read.csv("/Volumes/paquette_a/slapehn/CellProportions_CANDLE_GAPPS/Results/BirthweightTranscriptome/BWz_DEGS_FDR<0.05_CellProp_060926.csv")
BW_PCA <- read.csv("/Volumes/paquette_a/slapehn/CellProportions_CANDLE_GAPPS/Results/BirthweightTranscriptome/BWz_DEGS_FDR<0.05_CellPropPCA_112125.csv")
```

### Upset Plot
```{r upset plot}
List_noSVA <- list("Birthweight"=BW$genes, "Birthweight w/Cell Prop"=BW_CellProp_LOO$genes, "Birthweight w/Cell Prop PCs"=BW_PCA$genes)
upset(fromList(List_noSVA))
```

### Make a Venn Diagram
Since we're only comparing three groups- I'll also make a venn diagram here as another option.
```{r VD diagram}
library(ggvenn)
ggvenn(List_noSVA, show_percentage = FALSE, set_name_size=5, text_size=6, fill_color=c("#0080A2", "gray", "#EC7625"))
```

### Heatmap
Note: 
```{r heatmap}
FullResults <- full_join(BW, BW_CellProp_LOO, by=c("genes"), suffix=c("_BW", "_CellProp")) 
FullResults2 <- full_join(FullResults, BW_PCA, by=c("genes"))
FullResultsFinal <- FullResults2 %>%
  dplyr::select(genes, logFC_BW, logFC_CellProp, logFC)

rownames(FullResultsFinal) <- FullResultsFinal$genes
FullResultsFinal <- FullResultsFinal %>%
  dplyr::select(-genes)
colnames(FullResultsFinal) <- c("BW", "BW + Cell Prop", "BW + Cell Prop PCs") 
#Sort
row_means <- rowMeans(FullResultsFinal, na.rm=TRUE)
FullResults_forheatmap <- FullResultsFinal[order(row_means) , ]


 library(pheatmap)
pheatmap(
  t(FullResults_forheatmap),
  scale = "none",         
  cluster_rows = TRUE,    
  cluster_cols = FALSE,    
  show_rownames = TRUE,   
  show_colnames = TRUE,   
  color = colorRampPalette(c("#0080A2", "white", "#EC7625"))(100), 
  na.col="grey", 
  fontsize_col=2,
  cellheight=20
)
```
